# Golden fixtures v1 — protected ranking rules

Copied unchanged from the old repository `Desktop\project-zero` at revision
`6c739b9cb6ca2517b845e381d39a36c50eccc59e`, `backend/tests/fixtures/golden/`. They were generated there by
`_generate.py` from the ORIGINAL v1 modules (git tag `v1-legacy`) on the frozen parity snapshot.

| File | sha256 | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `inbox_sample.json` | `a1af71497d308111e4c204e0348cf9a8b8fae078cfb0052894ce06e768398571` | input: 141 candidates (every 4th of the parity snapshot), `last_run` 2026-09-27 19:50:11 |
| `attention_themes.json` | `fc938d48ecb16c4d356cba4648b3b4bf9096a21a7961a3d14eb894e192ea1dfe` | v1 outputs per candidate: gate, entity_type/info, score_v2, differentiation, annotate, annotate_v3, annotate_v31, themes_for, lens_signals, technical_founder_evidence; constants |
| `connectors_text.json` | `f1220f27c10ba8df62b9bc7f9196460ddb1bb51e0dd4645772c33fa0399feaa6` | v1 text helpers per candidate (only `norm_company` is used by the ranking port) |

Never regenerate these from the NEW code: they are the oracle. `tests/dealflow/test_ranking_golden.py` checks the
sha256 values above before comparing anything.

`oracle_*.json` are generated by the OLD code at the same revision, run in the old interpreter through
`scripts/oracle/*_oracle.py` (`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_<name> goldens`); each records its provenance
(revision, clean tree). `oracle_conviction.json` (review 011): `taste.score`, `imq.evaluate` / `persist`,
`days_since` and `/api/meta` over a synthetic corpus at the fixed clock 2026-11-11 12:00.
`oracle_people_fold.json` (review 012): the old person-identity key `services/identity.fold` over a synthetic corpus of
72 names and non-string values (`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_people goldens`).
`oracle_network.json` (review 013): the old `people.listing()`, `ecosys.talent_tree()` and the `/api/watchlist` body over
five synthetic people sets (dates and the due boundary, sort ties, a graph with a cycle / shared descendant / depth
limit, link-type quirks, a dict-shaped collection) at two clocks (2026-11-11 12:00 and 2026-11-12 00:30), plus
`STRENGTHS`, `POTENTIAL`, `FIELDS` and `_slug` (`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_network goldens`).
`oracle_events_when.json` (review 014): the old `domain/events.py` `parse_when`, `extract_date` and `event_span` over a
synthetic corpus of 100 date values and 30 start / end pairs at two fixed clocks (2026-03-15 and 2026-11-11), each result
`{ok}` or `{raises}` (`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_events goldens`).
`oracle_radar.json` (review 019): the old `radar_view` composition, `compose_radar` on each bar and boundary,
`memo` / `email` per signal, `weekly_update` with and without insight / question, and the `render_radar` document's
bytes, over a synthetic data folder of 40 invented companies, people and events at 2026-11-11 12:00
(`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_radar goldens`).
`oracle_ecosystems.json` (review 022): the old `city_registry`, `city_page` for every city (and an unknown one),
`coverage.report` and a 12-step `adopt_candidate` script with the coverage view and Deal Flow registry after each
step, over synthetic data folders of invented names (a main corpus, a defaults / malformed variant, and broken
regions) at 2026-11-11 12:00 (`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_ecosystems goldens`).
`oracle_founder_calls.json` (review 023): the old Founder Calls routes (workspace, every call / memo / briefing and
a 39-step save / follow-up / link script with the workspace and the stored document's key order after each step)
over synthetic documents of invented names whose insertion order differs from JSONB order, at 2026-11-12 10:00
(`python -m projectzero.ops.parity_founder_calls goldens`).
